Intersection of Main Road and 5th Avenue, Sandton
IPOL-2025-JPC-FL-001

Minor collision at controlled intersection. Our vehicle was stationary waiting for traffic light when rear-ended by private vehicle. Impact speed estimated at 15-20 km/h. Both drivers exchanged information at scene.
Rear bumper: dent and scratches on left side. Taillight housing cracked. Rear panel minor dent. Estimated repair cost R8,500.
Private vehicle - White Toyota Corolla, Reg: ABC 123 GP. Front bumper damage and headlight broken. Driver: John Smith, ID: 7501015123084, Contact: 082 555 1234.
No injuries to either driver or passengers. Both drivers able to continue. No emergency services required for medical assistance.
Witness 1: Mary Johnson, 081 777 8899. Pedestrian at intersection, saw entire incident. Witness 2: David Brown, 083 222 3344. Driver in adjacent lane, witnessed collision.
yes

Police called to scene, report filed. Insurance company notified same day. Vehicle moved to nearby safe location. Tow truck not required. Driver completed temporary incident report. Photos taken at scene. Vehicle returned to depot for assessment.
FLEET/ACC/00002
Parking area at Forum 1 Braam Park, 33 Hoofd Street, Braamfontein
IPOL-2025-JPC-FL-001

Parking incident while reversing in company parking area. Vehicle reversed into concrete pillar in basement parking. Low visibility conditions in basement area. Driver misjudged distance to pillar. Minor damage to rear of vehicle.
Rear bumper left corner damage. Paint scratch and small dent. Rear sensor housing cracked. Estimated repair cost R3,200.
No other vehicles involved. Single vehicle incident with fixed object (concrete pillar).
No injuries. Driver unharmed.
Security guard on duty: Peter Mokoena, 076 888 9999. Witness to incident. Building manager: Sarah Williams, 011 219 9000 ext 234.
no
Not applicable - private property incident

Incident reported to fleet office immediately. Building security notified. Photos taken of damage and pillar. Insurance company contacted. Vehicle assessment scheduled. Driver completed incident report form. Safety parking reminder issued to all drivers.
FLEET/ACC/00003
Main Road near Soweto, Johannesburg
IPOL-2025-JPC-FL-001

Road debris incident on highway. Large pothole in road could not be avoided safely. Vehicle hit pothole at approximately 60 km/h. Significant impact felt. Driver safely pulled over to check vehicle. Front left tire damaged.
Front left tire: sidewall rupture, tire needed replacement. Wheel rim: minor dent but serviceable. Front suspension inspected - no damage found. Total cost R2,850 for tire and wheel repair.
No other vehicles involved in incident.
No injuries. Driver shaken but unharmed.
Road maintenance crew working nearby: Supervisor contact 011 234 5678. Crew confirmed pothole was scheduled for repair but not yet completed.
no
Not applicable - road hazard incident

Vehicle moved to safe location off roadway. Emergency spare tire fitted at roadside. Tow service offered but declined. Vehicle driven slowly to nearest service center. Fleet office notified. Service center replaced damaged tire. Municipality notified about dangerous pothole condition. Location: GPS coordinates recorded.
